messages:
Emily Chen: Quick kickoff — CloudSilo marketplace listing + joint webinar/blog. Two asks: 1) benchmark narrative for launch post, 2) inbound lead routing + CRM mapping. Want to lock by EOD Friday.

Dave Patel: SGTM. Do we have a webinar date yet?

Emily Chen: Tentative: May 14th, 09:00 PT. Need to confirm with CloudSilo. If that slips we can do week of May 20th.

Alex R: For the benchmark narrative—are we leaning cost-per-token comparisons or latency/throughput focus? CloudSilo loves cost-savings messaging.

Maria Gomez: I'd push latency + reliability first (customer-facing), then a short cost line. Marketplaces perform better with clear performance claims + one concrete number.

Dave Patel: Agreed. Proposed headline: "Redwood + CloudSilo: Predictable inference at 20–40% lower unit cost for common LLM workloads" — then substantiated by our 1k-token chat benchmark. Thoughts?

Emily Chen: Love the direction. Can we be explicit on the benchmark conditions (model family, batch size, seq len)? Legal will need it.

Alex R: Draft numbers we can use: G-family 7B fp16, 2x A10s, steady-state throughput 120 reqs/min @ 128 tokens avg, P50 latency 80ms/token. We'll add methodology footnote.

Maria Gomez: That reads credible. Add a sentence about fallback routing to smaller quantized models when capacity spikes — ties into marketplace reliability story.

Olivia Park: On inbound routing — CloudSilo will send leads via marketplace webhook + shared lead CSV. We need mapping: marketplace_lead.id -> SFDC Lead.External_ID, company_size -> Lead.Number_of_Employees__c, interest_tag -> Lead.Product_Interest__c. Also capture utm_source=cloudsilo_marketplace for attribution.

Emily Chen: Good. @Dave can you own the SFDC field mapping and automation?

Dave Patel: Yep. I'll create a flow that upserts by External_ID and sets Lead.Source = "CloudSilo Marketplace", plus adds a Campaign Member to the co-marketing campaign.

Alex R: For routing SLA: mark any lead flagged as "priority" by CloudSilo and notify AE queue #marketplace-inbound within 10 minutes. Rule: if no AE accepts in 30m, auto-assign to growth team.

Maria Gomez: We'll need a short webhook spec to send to CloudSilo. Minimal fields: email, name, company, title, interest_tag, company_size, lead_id, utm params, priority_bool. Also timestamp.

Emily Chen: I'll draft the spec. Also need sample payload for engineering:

Emily Chen: ```json
{
  "lead_id": "CS-987654",
  "email": "jane@acme.com",
  "name": "Jane Ramos",
  "company": "ACME Corp",
  "title": "Head of AI",
  "interest_tag": "dedicated",
  "company_size": "200-1000",
  "utm_source": "cloudsilo_marketplace",
  "priority": true,
  "ts": 1768000000
}
```

Olivia Park: Perfect. For the webinar registration flow, CloudSilo will pass registrant tags — map those to Pardot lists so we can nurture product vs infra personas separately.

Dave Patel: Noted. We'll create two campaigns: "CS-Webinar-Infra" and "CS-Webinar-Product" and auto-enroll based on interest_tag.

Alex R: Marketing assets checklist (what we need from creative + CloudSilo):
- 1 hero co-branded PNG (1200x630)
- 2 social square variants (1:1)
- 1 blog feature image (1200x600)
- 1 short benchmark visual (png/svg) with the 20–40% callout
- Speaker headshots and bios (<= 50 words)
- Short webinar clip (30s) for post-event promo

Maria Gomez: I'll own the blog draft. Draft headline options: 
1) "How Redwood + CloudSilo Cut Inference Costs Without Sacrificing Latency"
2) "Predictable LLM Inference: Redwood + CloudSilo Benchmark"
3) "Faster, Cheaper, Safer: Our Marketplace Integration with CloudSilo"

Emily Chen: Option 2 is safest for marketplace SEO. Keep 1 as alternate for social.

Alex R: Blog structure proposal: Executive blurb -> benchmark methodology -> results -> customer scenario -> how to get started (marketplace link + CloudSilo setup steps) -> appendix with raw numbers + scripts.

Olivia Park: Also add a mini-FAQ: "Which models were tested? How does dedicated capacity affect results?" helps close technical objections.

Dave Patel: Quick ask for Legal/Compliance: we'll need a short consent checkbox on webinar registration that allows sharing contact with Redwood and CloudSilo. Can product ops craft wording?

Emily Chen: @Maria can you write the consent copy? Keep it simple: "By registering you consent to be contacted by Redwood Inference and CloudSilo about their products and services."

Maria Gomez: Done — will include in registration form.

Alex R: Timeline checkpoint:
- Tue: finalize benchmark numbers + methodology (alex)
- Wed: assets request to design (maria + emily)
- Thu: webhook spec and SFDC mapping ready (dave + emily)
- Fri: blog draft to review + landing page copy (maria)
- Next Mon: confirm webinar date with CloudSilo and publish registration

Emily Chen: I'll sync with CloudSilo after this thread and ping when date is locked.

cal-bot: Reminder: Calendar hold created for May 14, 09:00 PT — "Redwood x CloudSilo: Marketplace Launch Webinar". Use /accept to add to your calendar.

Dave Patel: One last ops note — ensure we include the marketplace SKU id in the webhook for the lead so product team can correlate conversions to the listing.

Olivia Park: Good catch. Add field sku_id -> Lead.SKU_Interested__c.

Emily Chen: Great progress. I'll post a follow-up once CloudSilo confirms the date and sends the initial attendee list format. Thanks team :thumbsup:

Maria Gomez: I'll start the blog draft and ping for numbers.

Alex R: Sending methodology doc in a second.

Dave Patel: Will prep the SFDC flow and demo it in #ops-sync tomorrow.

Emily Chen: End of thread — will update.
